headline: Iran warns of retaliation as strikes and shipping disruption spread
summary: Trump threatened more strikes, Kuwait reported drone attacks, and a tanker was hit near Oman as Iran’s war keeps the Strait of Hormuz under pressure.
script: Iran is warning of retaliation as the war threatens energy infrastructure. The Associated Press reports drone attacks on Kuwait and a tanker hit near Oman, while Al Jazeera says Iran is restricting passage through Hormuz. Shipping markets remain at risk.
imageAlt: Iranian missile displays and flags at a public exhibition in Tehran.
